title: Holding my Grandson
synopsis: Old Lady Wang’s daughter-in-law has already lost two babies. Will her daughter-in-law’s third pregnancy give her the grandson that she’s always wanted.

fullText.simplified:
医生走了，王老太太把气全都出在了娘家妈身上：“你看，你说不掏？现在连进去看看都不行。哼！切了你的女儿，也是你活该！但是要把我的孙子……我，我这条老命不要了！我和你没完！”
    娘家妈也慌了：是啊，真要把我女儿切了，那该怎么办啊？
    但事情都已经这样了，还能怎么办？娘家妈打起精神，和女儿的婆婆争道：“你怪我？我还怪你呢！是谁一天到晚给我女儿吃东西来着？没听医生说吗？我女儿就是吃太多了，才生不出来的。我见人见多了，从来没有见过像你这样的婆婆！”
    “哼！我给她吃？她在你们家的时候有吃过饱饭吗？”王老太太才不愿意受这个委屈呢！
    “在我们家没吃过饱饭？我们哪次去你们家看她，不是拿着大包小包吃的东西给她？”
    “所以，我给她吃了，你们大包小包的拿过来，没有给她吃吗？”
    婆婆和娘家妈气得声音都在发抖，两家人谁也不让谁。
    过了一会儿，医生又回来了。果然不出王老太太所料，得手术！虽然“手术”二字王老太太没听过，但想也想得出来。手要是竖起来，还不是要“掏”？
    医生说：“要是手术，大人小孩可能还能保得住。要是不手术，大人小孩都有生命危险。小孩已经误了三个小时了，而且根本不可能自然产下来，因为孩子太大了。不过，要是手术的话，得有亲人签字才行。”
    王老太太一个字也没听进去，只想着：“掏”是不行的！
    “怎么样，你们要快点决定！”医生很着急。
    “掏是不行的！”王老太太坚持。
    “签不签字？快点！”医生有点慌，时间就是生命啊！
    “我的孙子得自然出来！”王老太太不让步！
    娘家妈急了：“我签字行不行？”
    王老太太特别听不得这句话：“我的儿媳妇！你女儿嫁到我王家，生是我王家的人，死是我王家的鬼！你算老几？”
    医生真的急了，对着王老太太大声说道：“这可是两条人命！”
    “掏，就是不行！”
    “那么，你不想要孙子了？”医生想用孙子打动王老太太。
    果然有用！她半天没说话，眼前出现了她丈夫的鬼影，好像在对她说：“我们要孙子，掏出来的孙子也行！”
    王老太太让步了：“好吧！掏出来的也行。但是有一样，掏出来一定要是活的。”这是一定要说明的——要活的！掏出个死的来干嘛用？只要掏出活孙子来，儿媳妇就是死了也没关系。
fullText.traditional:
醫生走了，王老太太把氣全都出在了娘家媽身上：“你看，你說不掏？現在連進去看看都不行。哼！切了你的女兒，也是你活該！但是要把我的孫子……我，我這條老命不要了！我和你沒完！”
    娘家媽也慌了：是啊，真要把我女兒切了，那該怎麼辦啊？
    但事情都已經這樣了，還能怎麼辦？娘家媽打起精神，和女兒的婆婆爭道：“你怪我？我還怪你呢！是誰一天到晚給我女兒吃東西來著？沒聽醫生說嗎？我女兒就是吃太多了，才生不出來的。我見人見多了，從來沒有見過像你這樣的婆婆！”
    “哼！我給她吃？她在你們家的時候有吃過飽飯嗎？”王老太太才不願意受這個委屈呢！
    “在我們家沒吃過飽飯？我們哪次去你們家看她，不是拿著大包小包吃的東西給她？”
    “所以，我給她吃了，你們大包小包的拿過來，沒有給她吃嗎？”
    婆婆和娘家媽氣得聲音都在發抖，兩家人誰也不讓誰。
    過了一會兒，醫生又回來了。果然不出王老太太所料，得手術！雖然“手術”二字王老太太沒聽過，但想也想得出來。手要是豎起來，還不是要“掏”？
    醫生說：“要是手術，大人小孩可能還能保得住。要是不手術，大人小孩都有生命危險。小孩已經誤了三個小時了，而且根本不可能自然產下來，因為孩子太大了。不過，要是手術的話，得有親人簽字才行。”
    王老太太一個字也沒聽進去，只想著：“掏”是不行的！
    “怎麼樣，你們要快點決定！”醫生很著急。
    “掏是不行的！”王老太太堅持。
    “簽不簽字？快點！”醫生有點慌，時間就是生命啊！
    “我的孫子得自然出來！”王老太太不讓步！
    娘家媽急了：“我簽字行不行？”
    王老太太特別聽不得這句話：“我的兒媳婦！你女兒嫁到我王家，生是我王家的人，死是我王家的鬼！你算老幾？”
    醫生真的急了，對著王老太太大聲說道：“這可是兩條人命！”
    “掏，就是不行！”
    “那麼，你不想要孫子了？”醫生想用孫子打動王老太太。
    果然有用！她半天沒說話，眼前出現了她丈夫的鬼影，好像在對她說：“我們要孫子，掏出來的孫子也行！”
    王老太太讓步了：“好吧！掏出來的也行。但是有一樣，掏出來一定要是活的。”這是一定要說明的——要活的！掏出個死的來幹嘛用？只要掏出活孫子來，兒媳婦就是死了也沒關係。

sentences.simplified: 她半天没说话，眼前出现了她丈夫的鬼影，好像在对她说：
sentences.traditional: 她半天沒說話，眼前出現了她丈夫的鬼影，好像在對她說：
sentences.pinyin: tā bàn tiān méi shuō huà yǎn qián chū xiàn le tā zhàng fu de guǐ yǐng hǎo xiàng zài duì tā shuō
sentences.english: She didn’t speak for a long time. In front of her eyes appeared the shadow of her husband’s ghost, as if telling her, ..

sentences.simplified: “我们要孙子，掏出来的孙子也行！”
sentences.traditional: “我們要孫子，掏出來的孫子也行！”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men yào sūn zi tāo chū lái de sūn zi yě xíng
sentences.english: .. “We want a grandson. Even a grandson that has been scooped out will do!”

sentences.simplified: 王老太太让步了：“好吧！掏出来的也行。但是有一样，掏出来一定要是活的。”
sentences.traditional: 王老太太讓步了：“好吧！掏出來的也行。但是有一樣，掏出來一定要是活的。”
sentences.pinyin: wáng lǎo tài tai ràng bù le hǎo ba tāo chū lái de yě xíng dàn shì yǒu yí yàng tāo chū lái yí dìng yào shì huó de
sentences.english: Old Lady Wang conceded, “Very well! It can be scooped out. But one thing, it must be scooped out alive.”

sentences.simplified: 这是一定要说明的——要活的！掏出个死的来干嘛用？
sentences.traditional: 這是一定要說明的——要活的！掏出個死的來幹嘛用？
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì yí dìng yào shuō míng de yào huó de tāo chū ge sǐ de lái gàn má yòng
sentences.english: This must be explained – it must be alive! What’s the use of scooping it out dead?

sentences.simplified: 只要掏出活孙子来，儿媳妇就是死了也没关系。
sentences.traditional: 只要掏出活孫子來，兒媳婦就是死了也沒關係。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yào tāo chū huó sūn zi lái ér xí fu jiù shì sǐ le yě méi guān xi
sentences.english: As long as a living grandson is scooped out, it doesn’t matter if my daughter-in-law dies.

raw.synopsis: Old Lady Wang’s daughter-in-law has already lost two babies. Will her daughter-in-law’s third pregnancy give her the grandson that she’s always wanted.
sentence_translations: The doctor left, and Old Lady Wang took out all of her anger on her daughter-in-law’s mother.
“You see, you said no scooping out? Right now we can’t even go in to look.
Humph! Cutting your daughter serves you right!
But to make my grandson, … I, I, am old and don’t need this! Me and you are not finished!”
The mother also panicked. Yes, they are really going to cut my daughter, then what should I do?
But it has already come to this, what else can we do?
The mother summoned up the energy to argue with her daughter’s mother-in-law ..
.. “You blame me? I blame you! Who was it that fed my daughter all day? Didn’t you hear the doctor?
My daughter has eaten too much so she can’t give birth.
I’ve met many people, but I’ve never come across a mother-in-law like you!”
“Humph! I fed her? When she was in your home did she ever have a good meal?”
Old Lady Wang would not allow herself to suffer this grievance!
”In our home she never had a good meal?
Which time when we’ve gone to your home to see her have we not brought big and small containers of food for her?“
”So, I’m feeding her, and the big and small containers that you bring, are not feeding her?”
The mother and mother-in-law were so angry that their voices trembled. Neither of them would yield to the other.
After a while, the doctor returned. Sure enough, as Old Lady Wang expected, they needed to do a surgical operation!
Even though “surgical operation” were two words that Old Lady Wang had never heard of before, she figured it out.
If you are going to open the hands, doesn’t that mean you are going to “scoop out” the baby.
The doctor said, “If we do a surgical operation, we might be able to save both the adult and the child.
If we don’t do a surgical operation, the lives of both the adult and child will be in a danger.
The child has already been delayed for three hours. A natural birth is simply not possible because the child is too big.
But, if we do a surgical operation, we need a close relative to sign.”
Old Lady Wang did not hear a single word. She only thought, “Scooping out” is out of the question!
“What’s it going to be, you have to quickly decide!” The doctor was very anxious.
“Scooping out is out of the question!” Old Lady Wang persisted.
“Are you going to sign or not? Quick!” The doctor became a little panicked, time is critical!
“My grandson must come out naturally!” Old Lady Wang refused to concede!
The biological mother was anxious, “Is it okay if I sign?”
Old Lady Wang was particularly unable to accept this, “My daughter-in-law! Your daughter married into our Wang family.
When she is alive she is member of the Wang family, and when she is dead she is a ghost of the Wang family!!
Who are you to speak?”
The doctor was really anxious, and facing Old Lady Wang said, “But this is two lives!”
“Scooping out is out of the question!”
“Well then, you don’t want a grandson?” The doctor wanted to use the grandson to move Old Lady Wang.
Sure enough, it worked.
She didn’t speak for a long time. In front of her eyes appeared the shadow of her husband’s ghost, as if telling her, ..
.. “We want a grandson. Even a grandson that has been scooped out will do!”
Old Lady Wang conceded, “Very well! It can be scooped out. But one thing, it must be scooped out alive.”
This must be explained – it must be alive! What’s the use of scooping it out dead?
As long as a living grandson is scooped out, it doesn’t matter if my daughter-in-law dies.
